'''Darth Nurin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Darth Nurin was known to have taken at least one apprentice, the Zabrak Lord [[Velnine]].<ref name="TOR" />

In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|1.2}}</ref> she was tasked with the mission to ally the Empire to the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], following a lull in hostilities with the Republic. She could be found in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Fleet]] in the Operations Center of the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''. It was during this time that [[Sannus Lorrick|Doctor Lorrick]] released his weaponized version of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], sending the Hegemony spiraling into chaos as citizens attempted to escape their doomed worlds. In order to combat this [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|pandemic]], while hoping to gain access to the virus itself for the Empire, she researched the new strain and sent imperial spacers to contain the threat on [[Kaon]].<ref name="TOR" />

Following their successful return, she then [[Mission to the Lost Island|sent]] them after the fugitive Doctor Lorrick, hiding in his [[Lost Island|laboratory]] somewhere on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], to both remove him as a threat and to strengthen ties with the Hegemony.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Nurin introduces the Imperial players to the new flashpoints Kaon Under Siege and The Lost Island.<ref name="TOR" />
